purpose: CFR-OAP-001: an authorized role can use a permitted OAP function.
preconditions: A registered student user exists with the Student role.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application (a function permitted to Students).
expected_result: The request is accepted and the leave application is created.

purpose: CFR-OAP-001: an unauthorized role is denied a protected OAP function.
preconditions: A registered student user exists with the Student role only; a submitted leave application exists.
action_or_input: The student attempts to approve the leave application (an HoD-only function).
expected_result: The action is denied and the leave application status is unchanged.

purpose: CFR-OAP-001: each user is restricted to OAP information/functions relevant to their role.
preconditions: Two students (S1, S2) each have a submitted leave application; an HoD exists.
action_or_input: S1 retrieves leave records; S2 retrieves leave records.
expected_result: Each student can retrieve only their own leave records and cannot retrieve the other student's records.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: submission-event notification.
preconditions: A student exists; the relevant recipient (HoD) exists.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application.
expected_result: A system alert and an email notification are both issued for the submission event to the required recipient.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: approval-event notification.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; HoD exists.
action_or_input: The HoD approves the leave application.
expected_result: A system alert and an email notification are both issued for the approval event to the required recipient.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: rejection-event notification.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; HoD exists.
action_or_input: The HoD rejects the leave application.
expected_result: A system alert and an email notification are both issued for the rejection event to the required recipient.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: no-dues verification-completion notification.
preconditions: A no-dues case exists with six of seven authority results recorded.
action_or_input: The seventh authority records its result so that no-dues verification is complete.
expected_result: A system alert and an email notification are both issued for no-dues verification completion to the required recipient.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: certificate-availability notification for an approved bonafide certificate.
preconditions: A verified bonafide request exists.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator approves the bonafide request so the certificate becomes available.
expected_result: The requesting student receives a system alert and an email notification that the certificate is available.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: certificate-availability notification for a finalized no-dues certificate.
preconditions: A no-dues case exists with all seven results Clear.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator finalizes no-dues clearance so the certificate becomes available.
expected_result: The requesting student receives a system alert and an email notification that the certificate is available.

purpose: CFR-OAP-002: pending-action reminder to the responsible actor.
preconditions: A request is pending an action by a responsible actor and a pending-action reminder condition is configured and met.
action_or_input: The reminder condition is triggered.
expected_result: The responsible actor is sent a reminder through the supported channel(s). No specific schedule/threshold is asserted.

purpose: CFR-OAP-003: student submits a leave application.
preconditions: An authorized student exists.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application with the required request data.
expected_result: A leave application is created in Submitted state for the student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-003: leave submission with an optional supporting document.
preconditions: An authorized student exists; a supporting document is available.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application with the supporting document attached.
expected_result: The application is created and the supplied document is retained with the request.

purpose: CFR-OAP-003: leave submission without the optional supporting document.
preconditions: An authorized student exists.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application with no supporting document.
expected_result: The application is created successfully without a document.

purpose: CFR-OAP-003: submitted leave is available to the appropriate HoD.
preconditions: A student and the student's appropriate HoD exist.
action_or_input: The student submits a leave application.
expected_result: The leave application is available to the appropriate HoD for review.

purpose: CFR-OAP-004: HoD reviews leave application and supporting info.
preconditions: A submitted leave application with a supporting document exists, available to the appropriate HoD.
action_or_input: The HoD opens the leave application.
expected_result: The HoD can view the application content and the supplied supporting information.

purpose: CFR-OAP-004: HoD approves a leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application is available to the HoD.
action_or_input: The HoD records Approved.
expected_result: The leave application's persistent status becomes Approved.

purpose: CFR-OAP-004: HoD rejects a leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application is available to the HoD.
action_or_input: The HoD records Rejected.
expected_result: The leave application's persistent status becomes Rejected.

purpose: CFR-OAP-005: student tracks current leave status.
preconditions: A student has submitted leave applications in differing statuses (e.g., Submitted, Approved).
action_or_input: The student retrieves the status of each submitted leave application.
expected_result: The current status of each submitted leave application is returned correctly.

purpose: CFR-OAP-005: leave history is maintained and retrievable.
preconditions: A student has several past leave requests (including decided ones).
action_or_input: The student retrieves their leave history.
expected_result: All past leave requests remain represented in the retrievable history.

purpose: CFR-OAP-006: student submits a bonafide request.
preconditions: An authorized student exists.
action_or_input: The student submits a bonafide certificate request.
expected_result: A bonafide request is created in Submitted state.

purpose: CFR-OAP-006: submitted bonafide request is available to the Academic Administrator.
preconditions: An Academic Administrator exists.
action_or_input: A student submits a bonafide request.
expected_result: The request becomes available to the Academic Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-007: Academic Administrator verifies a bonafide request.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator reviews/verifies the request.
expected_result: The administrator can review/verify the submitted request.

purpose: CFR-OAP-007: Academic Administrator approves a verified bonafide request.
preconditions: A verified bonafide request exists.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator records Approved.
expected_result: The request status becomes Approved.

purpose: CFR-OAP-007: Academic Administrator rejects a verified bonafide request.
preconditions: A verified bonafide request exists.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator records Rejected.
expected_result: The request status becomes Rejected.

purpose: CFR-OAP-008: student monitors bonafide request status.
preconditions: A student has submitted bonafide requests.
action_or_input: The student retrieves the status of the submitted bonafide requests.
expected_result: The current status of each request is returned to the requesting student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-008: requesting student can download an approved bonafide certificate.
preconditions: A bonafide request has been approved.
action_or_input: The requesting student downloads the bonafide certificate.
expected_result: The certificate is available and downloadable by the requesting student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-008: certificate is available only after approval.
preconditions: A bonafide request exists that is Submitted/not approved (and one that is Rejected).
action_or_input: The requesting student attempts to download the bonafide certificate.
expected_result: No certificate is available for download.

purpose: CFR-OAP-009: student initiates no-dues clearance.
preconditions: An authorized student exists.
action_or_input: The student initiates a no-dues clearance request.
expected_result: An active no-dues clearance case is created for the student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-009: no-dues request is routed in parallel to all seven authorities.
preconditions: A no-dues case has just been initiated by a student.
action_or_input: Inspect the routing of the case after initiation.
expected_result: The case is issued to Library, Hostel, Mess, respective Department, Lab, Academic Section and Student Section simultaneously (all seven pending at once).

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Library clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Library authority.
action_or_input: The Librarian records the Library clearance result.
expected_result: The Library domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Hostel clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Hostel authority.
action_or_input: The Hostel Warden records the Hostel clearance result.
expected_result: The Hostel domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Mess clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Mess authority.
action_or_input: The Mess In-charge records the Mess clearance result.
expected_result: The Mess domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Lab clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Lab authority.
action_or_input: The Lab Supervisor records the Lab clearance result.
expected_result: The Lab domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Department clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Department authority.
action_or_input: The authorized verifier for the student's respective Department records the Department clearance result.
expected_result: The Department domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Academic Section clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Academic Section authority.
action_or_input: The authorized Academic Section verifier records the Academic Section clearance result.
expected_result: The Academic Section domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: Student Section clearance can be recorded by its authority.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists and is routed to the Student Section authority.
action_or_input: The authorized Student Section verifier records the Student Section clearance result.
expected_result: The Student Section domain result is recorded for the relevant no-dues case.

purpose: CFR-OAP-010: seven authority results are maintained separately.
preconditions: An active no-dues case exists.
action_or_input: Seven authorities record distinct results (e.g., six Clear and one Not Clear) and the case is retrieved.
expected_result: All seven results are stored independently and remain individually distinguishable.

purpose: CFR-OAP-011: Academic Administrator reviews the consolidated set.
preconditions: A no-dues case has all seven authority results recorded.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator reviews/consolidates the results.
expected_result: The complete set of seven results is available for review.

purpose: CFR-OAP-011: finalization succeeds when all seven results are received and Clear.
preconditions: A no-dues case has all seven results recorded as Clear.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator finalizes the no-dues clearance.
expected_result: Finalization succeeds.

purpose: CFR-OAP-011: finalization is blocked when not all seven verifications are received.
preconditions: A no-dues case has only six results recorded, all Clear.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator attempts to finalize.
expected_result: Finalization is refused and the case is not finalized.

purpose: CFR-OAP-011: finalization is blocked when any result is not Clear.
preconditions: A no-dues case has all seven results recorded, six Clear and one Not Clear.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator attempts to finalize.
expected_result: Finalization is refused and the case is not finalized.

purpose: CFR-OAP-012: student tracks no-dues progress by authority.
preconditions: A no-dues case has some authority results recorded and others pending.
action_or_input: The student views no-dues progress.
expected_result: Each authority's status and the overall progress are visible to the student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-012: finalized no-dues certificate is available to the student.
preconditions: A no-dues case has been finalized.
action_or_input: The requesting student downloads the no-dues certificate.
expected_result: The certificate is available and downloadable by the requesting student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-013: PG student submits an assistantship claim.
preconditions: An authorized PG student exists.
action_or_input: The PG student submits an assistantship claim.
expected_result: An assistantship claim is created in Submitted state.

purpose: CFR-OAP-013: claim is routed to both assigned supervisors.
preconditions: A PG student has an assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: The PG student submits an assistantship claim.
expected_result: The claim is routed for verification to both the assigned Thesis Supervisor role and the assigned TA Supervisor role.

purpose: CFR-OAP-014: each supervisor role records its own verification.
preconditions: A routed claim exists; Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor roles are held by different faculty members.
action_or_input: The Thesis Supervisor and the TA Supervisor each record verification for their role.
expected_result: Each role's verification is recorded and the two are separately represented.

purpose: CFR-OAP-014: one faculty holding both roles records both role-verifications separately.
preconditions: A routed claim exists; one faculty member holds both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor roles for the student.
action_or_input: The faculty member records verification as Thesis Supervisor and as TA Supervisor.
expected_result: Two separate role-verifications are recorded; both are required and separately represented.

purpose: CFR-OAP-014: claim is not available to Department Administrator until both verifications exist.
preconditions: A routed claim has only one role-verification recorded (test with Thesis-only and with TA-only).
action_or_input: The Department Administrator attempts to access the claim for review.
expected_result: The claim is not available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-014: claim becomes available once both verifications are recorded.
preconditions: A routed claim; both role-verifications are then recorded.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator accesses the claim.
expected_result: The claim is available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-015: Department Administrator reviews a fully verified claim.
preconditions: A claim has both supervisor-role verifications recorded.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator reviews the claim.
expected_result: The review succeeds and the claim is recorded as reviewed.

purpose: CFR-OAP-015: Department Administrator forwards a reviewed claim to HoD.
preconditions: A claim has been reviewed by the Department Administrator.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator forwards the claim.
expected_result: The claim is forwarded to and becomes available to the HoD.

purpose: CFR-OAP-016: HoD approves a reviewed assistantship claim.
preconditions: A claim has both verifications and Department Administrator review/forwarding.
action_or_input: The HoD records Approved.
expected_result: The claim status becomes Approved.

purpose: CFR-OAP-016: HoD rejects a reviewed assistantship claim.
preconditions: A claim has both verifications and Department Administrator review/forwarding.
action_or_input: The HoD records Rejected.
expected_result: The claim status becomes Rejected.

purpose: CFR-OAP-016: an HoD-approved claim is available to the Academic Administrator.
preconditions: A claim has been approved by the HoD.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator accesses claims awaiting stipend processing.
expected_result: The approved claim is available to the Academic Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-016: only a HoD-approved claim becomes available to the Academic Administrator.
preconditions: A claim has been rejected by the HoD.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator accesses claims awaiting stipend processing.
expected_result: The rejected claim is not available to the Academic Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-017: Academic Administrator processes stipend disbursement.
preconditions: A HoD-approved claim exists.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator records completion of stipend processing.
expected_result: Stipend processing is recorded as complete for the claim.

purpose: CFR-OAP-018: PG student tracks claim stage.
preconditions: A PG student's claim has progressed through at least one stage.
action_or_input: The PG student retrieves the claim status.
expected_result: The claim's current processing stage/status is returned.

purpose: CFR-OAP-019: record a thesis-supervisor assignment.
preconditions: A PG student and a faculty member exist; Department Administrator exists.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator records the faculty member as the student's Thesis Supervisor.
expected_result: The thesis-supervisor assignment is recorded for the PG student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-019: TA assignment to a course/subject.
preconditions: A PG student and a course exist.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator records a TA assignment linking the student to the course only.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with the course association.

purpose: CFR-OAP-019: TA assignment to a faculty member.
preconditions: A PG student and a faculty member exist.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator records a TA assignment linking the student to the faculty member only.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with the faculty association.

purpose: CFR-OAP-019: TA assignment to both a course and a faculty member.
preconditions: A PG student, a course and a faculty member exist.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator records a TA assignment linking the student to both the course and the faculty member.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with both associations.

purpose: CFR-OAP-020: PG student requests seminar scheduling.
preconditions: An authorized PG student exists.
action_or_input: The PG student submits a graduate-seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: A graduate-seminar request is created in Submitted state.

purpose: CFR-OAP-020: request is available to the Department Administrator.
preconditions: A Department Administrator exists.
action_or_input: A PG student submits a seminar request.
expected_result: The request becomes available to the Department Administrator.

purpose: CFR-OAP-021: Department Administrator schedules a seminar.
preconditions: A submitted seminar request exists.
action_or_input: The Department Administrator schedules the seminar.
expected_result: The seminar is recorded in Scheduled state.

purpose: CFR-OAP-021: seminar scheduling history/log is maintained.
preconditions: One or more seminars have been scheduled.
action_or_input: Retrieve the seminar scheduling history/log.
expected_result: A retrievable history/log of the scheduling records exists.

purpose: CFR-OAP-022: PG student views seminar schedules.
preconditions: A seminar has been scheduled; a PG student exists.
action_or_input: The PG student views graduate seminar schedules.
expected_result: The scheduled seminar is visible to the PG student.

purpose: CFR-OAP-022: faculty member views seminar schedules.
preconditions: A seminar has been scheduled; a faculty member exists.
action_or_input: The faculty member views graduate seminar schedules.
expected_result: The scheduled seminar is visible to the faculty member.
